title: Ukraine war latest: Camo-clad Putin visits Russian frontline as Trump ramps up ceasefire pressure

title: Ukrainian forces flee Kursk after losing key city within pocket
description: In August, Ukraine launched the first invasion of Russia since World War II, rapidly seizing some 386 square miles centered on the city of Sudzha in Kursk.

title: Putin lands in Kursk wearing military fatigues before US officials arrive in Moscow. What is he hinting at?
description: Russian President Vladimir Putin visited Kursk, the western Russian region, on Wednesday for the first time since Ukrainian forces partially occupied it. His visit comes as Russia is on the verge of driving Kyiv's troops out of Kursk.

title: Trump says negotiators headed to Russia 'right now' after Ukraine agrees to truce

title: Rubio Says a Cease-Fire in Ukraine Could Happen in ‘Days’ if Russia Agrees
description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said top diplomats from the Group of 7 allies meeting in Canada should focus on ending the war. And he shrugged off President Trump’s threats to annex Canada.
